title: A signal about water
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: ADH can increase collecting-duct water permeability and reabsorption. It is produced in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which hormone released from the posterior pituitary can increase water reabsorption in kidney collecting ducts? ADH can increase collecting-duct water permeability and reabsorption. It is produced in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases ADH into the circulation? ADH can increase collecting-duct water permeability and reabsorption. It is produced in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.
